units.source_text: 源氏公子想立刻溜出去，不让对方知道他是何人。

en.t: Prince Genji wanted to slip out at once without letting the other man know who he was.

units.source_text: 但念自己衣衫不整，帽子歪戴，想象这仓皇出走的后影实甚可笑，便踌躇不决。

en.t: But when he thought of his disheveled clothes and crooked cap, and imagined how ridiculous he would look hurrying away in such a panic, he hesitated.

units.source_text: 头中将想教源氏公子不知道他是谁，故而默不作声，只是做出非常愤怒的动作，把佩刀拔了出来。

en.t: The Captain wanted to keep Prince Genji from recognizing him, so he said nothing, merely acted as if he were furious, and drew his sword.

units.source_text: 内侍着了急，连喊“喂，我的好人！喂，我的好人！”走上前去向他合掌叩头。

en.t: The Naishi grew frantic and cried again and again, "Oh, my dear sir! Oh, my dear sir!" as she stepped forward, pressed her hands together, and bowed her head to him.

units.source_text: 头中将觉得太滑稽了，差一点噗嗤地笑了出来。

en.t: The Captain found it so absurd that he almost burst out laughing.

units.source_text: 内侍表面上装作一个娇艳的少女，粗看倒也像模像样，但实际上却是个五十七八岁的老太婆。

en.t: Outwardly, the Naishi played the part of a charming young girl, and at a glance she even seemed convincing, but in truth she was an old woman of fifty-seven or fifty-eight.

units.source_text: 此时她忘记了一切，夹在两个美貌无比的二十来岁的青年贵公子中间，

en.t: At that moment she forgot everything, caught between two incomparably handsome young noblemen in their twenties,

units.source_text: 周章狼狈地调停排解，这样子实在滑稽之极！

en.t: and flustered and helpless, she tried to mediate between them; the sight was utterly ridiculous.
